places.name: Hoan Kiem Lake
places.ai_summary: A serene lake in the heart of Hanoi, featuring the iconic Turtle Tower and a peaceful walking path.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or evening.

places.place_tip: Visit during the weekend to enjoy the pedestrian-only streets.

attribution.title: Thap Rua
attribution.author: Cyril Doussin from London, United Kingdom
attribution.description: Turtle Tower amid the Hoàn Kiếm Lake

places.name: Old Quarter
places.ai_summary: A bustling area with narrow streets, traditional shops, and a vibrant atmosphere showcasing Hanoi’s rich culture.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes have individual opening hours.

places.place_tip: Explore on foot to fully experience the charm of the area.

attribution.title: Old Quarter Street Scene - Hanoi - Vietnam (48256301206)
attribution.author: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada
attribution.description: Old Quarter Street Scene - Hanoi - Vietnam

places.name: Temple of Literature
places.ai_summary: Vietnam’s first national university, this temple complex is dedicated to Confucius and features beautiful gardens and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful lotus pond.

attribution.title: Hanoi Temple of Literature (cropped)
attribution.author: The original uploader was Chuoibk at English Wikipedia.
attribution.description: Main entrance of the Temple of Literature in Hanoi, Vietnam.

places.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
places.ai_summary: The final resting place of Vietnam’s founding father, Ho Chi Minh, this mausoleum is a place of great reverence and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary; check in advance.

places.place_tip: Dress respectfully and maintain silence inside the mausoleum.
places.address: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Hanoi, Vietnam

places.name: One Pillar Pagoda
places.ai_summary: An iconic symbol of Hanoi, this unique pagoda is built on a single stone pillar and is surrounded by a lotus pond.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the nearby Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum.

places.name: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology
places.ai_summary: A fascinating museum showcasing the diverse cultures and ethnic groups of Vietnam through artifacts, photographs, and traditional houses.

opening_hours.notes: Plan at least 2 hours for your visit.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the outdoor exhibition area with traditional houses.
places.address: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, Hanoi, Vietnam

attribution.title: Dan toc hoc 1
attribution.author: vi:User:Rungbachduong
attribution.description: Entrance to the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology

places.name: Hoa Lo Prison
places.ai_summary: Also known as the Hanoi Hilton, this historic prison-turned-museum offers a glimpse into Vietnam’s turbulent past.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for more in-depth information.

attribution.title: HanoiHilton
attribution.author: Hohum
attribution.description: The Hoa Lo Prison, dubbed the Hanoi Hilton by the American POWs held there during the Vietnam War.

places.name: West Lake
places.ai_summary: The largest lake in Hanoi, West Lake is a popular spot for both locals and tourists, offering scenic views and a tranquil escape from the city’s hustle and bustle.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food around the lake.

places.name: Tran Quoc Pagoda
places.ai_summary: The oldest pagoda in Hanoi, located on a small island in West Lake, Tran Quoc Pagoda is a serene and picturesque spot.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with West Lake.

attribution.title: Tran Quoc Buddhist Pagoda, Hanoi, 6th century (24) (37610879445)
attribution.author: Richard Mortel from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
attribution.description: Tran Quoc Buddhist Pagoda, Hanoi, 6th century (24)

places.name: St. Joseph’s Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of neo-Gothic architecture in Hanoi, this cathedral is famous for its beautiful stained-glass windows and peaceful garden.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times if you wish to attend.

places.place_tip: Take time to explore the surrounding area.

attribution.title: St. Joseph's Cathedral - Hanoi, Vietnam
attribution.author: Arno Kohlem

places.name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
places.ai_summary: Experience the unique art of water puppetry, a traditional Vietnamese performance, in this iconic theatre.

opening_hours.notes: Book tickets in advance, especially on weekends.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to get good seats.
places.address: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre, Hanoi, Vietnam

attribution.title: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre2
attribution.author: Gryffindor
attribution.description: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre in Hanoi

places.name: Dong Xuan Market
places.ai_summary: The largest market in Hanoi, Dong Xuan Market is a bustling place to experience local life and shop for souvenirs, clothes, and street food.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Be prepared to bargain for the best prices.

attribution.title: Dong Xuan market
attribution.author: Juliana Ng from Singapore

places.name: Vietnamese Women’s Museum
places.ai_summary: This museum is dedicated to the women of Vietnam, showcasing their contributions and highlighting gender issues through various exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed insights.

attribution.title: Vietnamese Women's Museum
attribution.author: Christophe95
attribution.description: The Vietnamese Women's Museum in Hanoi.

places.name: Ba Dinh Square
places.ai_summary: A historic square in Hanoi, Ba Dinh Square is known for its significant monuments and as the site of Ho Chi Minh’s mausoleum.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning.

places.place_tip: Watch the flag raising ceremony if you can.

attribution.title: Lăng Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh, Hà Nội
attribution.author: Linhcandng (thảo luận)
attribution.description: Lăng Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh, Hà Nội

places.name: Long Bien Bridge
places.ai_summary: An iconic cantilever bridge in Hanoi, Long Bien Bridge offers stunning views of the Red River and is a popular spot for photographers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Be careful of traffic when visiting.

attribution.title: Long bien bridge
attribution.author: Pierre De Hanscutter
attribution.description: Pont Long Bien, construit dans le style Eiffel à Hanoï, Vietnam. En partie détruit par les bombardements pendant la guerre du Vietnam

places.name: Ngoc Son Temple
places.ai_summary: A picturesque temple located on an island in Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple is dedicated to the legendary hero Tran Hung Dao.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with Hoan Kiem Lake.

attribution.title: Ngoc Son Temple, Hanoi (15) (37780892234)
attribution.author: Richard Mortel from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

places.name: Lotte Observation Deck
places.ai_summary: Enjoy a panoramic view of Hanoi from the Lotte Observation Deck, located in the Lotte Center Hanoi.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 21:30.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to avoid queues.
places.address: Lotte Center Hanoi, 54 Liễu Giai, Ba Đình, Hanoi, Vietnam

places.name: Hanoi Opera House
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of French colonial architecture, the Hanoi Opera House is a cultural and historical landmark in the city.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for performance times.

places.place_tip: Consider watching a performance for a complete experience.
places.address: Hanoi Opera House, 01 Tràng Tiền, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi, Vietnam

places.name: Hanoi Train Street
places.ai_summary: A famous narrow street where trains pass closely by houses and shops, offering a unique and thrilling experience.

opening_hours.notes: Be cautious and stay safe while visiting.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the nearby cafes for a unique view.

attribution.title: Hanoi Train Street (20231225b) (53489076293)
attribution.author: Takeshi Aida from Hong Kong, Hong Kong

places.name: Thang Long Imperial Citadel
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, this ancient citadel offers a glimpse into Vietnam’s royal past with its well-preserved architecture and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history.
places.address: Thang Long Imperial Citadel, Hanoi, Vietnam
